source_text:
17.20
̔Ρύσεταί με, ο τι
ἐθέλησέν με. Ου τως ὁ ὑπὸ τῆς σῆς προνοίας ῥυσθεὶς, ἐλπίζω πάντων περιγενέσθαι
τῶν δυσμενῶν, καὶ μὴ πρότερον ἀποστῆναι, ε ως αὐτοὺς αυ θις ὑπηκόους
εἰργάσωμαι· τοῦτο γὰρ καὶ παρεδήλωσεν εἰρηκώς· Πεσοῦνται ὑπὸ τοὺς πόδας μου.
pass_a_gloss: He-will-rescue me, because he-willed me. Thus the under the of-you providence having-been-rescued, I-hope of-all to-prevail of-the hostile-ones, and not beforehand to-withdraw, until them again obedient I-work; this for also he-hinted having-said: They-will-fall under the feet of-me.
pass_b_english: “He will rescue me, because he delighted in me” (Psalm 17:20).

Thus I, having been rescued by your providence, hope to prevail over all the hostile, and not to withdraw first, until I make them subject again; for this he also hinted when he said: “They will fall under my feet” (Psalm 17:39).

choices.english: He will rescue me, because he delighted in me
choices.why: ὅτι is because, not apposition. OCR ο τι. Not ‘the one who willed me’. No πλατυσμός in this lock cut.
rejected: He will deliver me, the one who willed me
he brought me out into a broad place

choices.term: Οὕτως ὁ ὑπὸ τῆς σῆς προνοίας ῥυσθείς
choices.english: Thus I, having been rescued by your providence
choices.why: Οὕτως is thus, not οὐχ οὕτως. First person of the rescued speaker.
rejected: Not thus the one delivered by your providence

choices.term: μὴ πρότερον ἀποστῆναι, ἕως αὐτοὺς αὖθις ὑπηκόους εἰργάσωμαι
choices.english: not to withdraw first, until I make them subject again
choices.why: OCR ε ως / αυ θις is ἕως αὖθις, not αὐτούς twice. ἀποστῆναι is withdraw, not ‘not before making’.

choices.english: he also hinted when he said
choices.why: παραδηλόω is to hint / indicate besides, not a full declaration.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
